payload.description: The council's page about its officers names the chief executive and the executive directors but not the holder of the monitoring officer post, so this page does not name them either. Officer pay is published as a band for the grade, not as what an individual is paid, and no council document links a named officer to a band — that join is ours, made from the officers page for the name and the salaries list for the band.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
